name: 11-30-21 City Council Special Agenda
minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  November 30, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  November 30, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into at the hour of 2:00 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Padilla, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  Council Members Dotson, and Morales.
  City Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager/CFO
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any
  persons present who wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.
  There was no response.

183  BID NO. RFB-0145 REJECTED – STAGE AND EQUIPMENT FOR SUPER
  BOWL CONCERT SERIES PROJECT. Staff report dated November 30, 2021, was
  presented recommending rejection of all bids for the Stage and Equipment for Super
  Bowl Concert Series Project (Bid No. RFB-0145).

  It was moved by Council Member Padilla, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby reject all bids. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 2:01 p.m.

  Approved this ______ day of _______, 2022.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
